summary: Bowhead Specialty Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive merger agreement with American Family Mutual Insurance Company (Parent) and its subsidiary Trident Superior Inc. Under the agreement, each Bowhead share will be converted into $34.00 cash. The merger is structured as a cash tender offer followed by a squeeze-out merger, making Bowhead a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. The board recommends the transaction. Unvested RSUs are assumed and converted into cash escrow interests, except for the CEO's, which are treated separately. The filing notes regulatory approvals and appraisal rights. Watch for tender offer launch and closing conditions, with arbitrage focused on regulatory timeline and deal certainty.
